basic_profile.bio: A digital nomad originally from Brisbane, Australia, who has been exploring the world while working remotely as a software developer. Passionate about technology, gaming, and social justice. Enjoys attending music festivals like Welcome to Rockville and is a huge NBA fan. Usually online during late evenings, wherever they might be. Openly gay and currently in a long-distance relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Computer Science and has over a decade of experience in software development, specializing in game development and graphics optimization. Learned through a mix of formal education, self-study, and hands-on experience in the industry.
